questions.question:
Seven boys Laxman, Mohan, Bit, Sohil. Rahul, Ram and Ramesh are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Sohil is third to the left of Bittu. Mohan is second to the right of Bittu. Ram is third to the right of Ramesh. Ramesh is not the immediate neighbour of Mohan. Laxman is third to the left of Rahul.

Who is to the immediate left of Ram?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Seven boys Laxman, Mohan, Bit, Sohil. Rahul, Ram and Ramesh are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

**Explanation : **

1) Sohil is third to the left of Bittu.

2) Mohan is second to the right of Bittu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49339698f31c215da90edb1691c0dde3d671957af41ade321af7d97894b34397.png] 

3) Ramesh is not the immediate neighbour of Mohan.

4) Ram is third to the right of Ramesh. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cac8fc80e63f9c1ac837f3cd8a2bc54cd8be053f42c5e13442d22af788219ce.png] 

5) Laxman is third to the left of Rahul.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/753c812b568d195790c46806b7748bb084561db45a7f887a6a8da3375c1e70d0.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Bittu is to the immediate left of Ram.

Hence, "**Bittu**" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements,

**Statements:**

I. Some V are P.

II. Some F are V.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some F are P.

II. Some V are F.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c19b489bde4d88ef99b0cb5794719af741cc2bbf1cd140b93fdd20944b3ff7ff.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some F are P → Does not follow (As some V are P and some F are V. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some V are F → Follow (As some F are V. So, as some part of F is common with V therefore it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion II follows".

questions.question:
Seven girls Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal and Laxmi are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Aarti is second to the left of Kajal. Monika is third to the right of Kajal. Mansi is not the immediate neighbour of Kajal. Laxmi is second to the left of Mansi. Payal is not the immediate neighbour of Laxmi

Who is second to the left of Laxmi?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Seven girls Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti, Kajal and Laxmi are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre

**Explanation :**

1) Aarti is second to the left of Kajal.

2) Monika is third to the right of Kajal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5160aa1120d1c0eaeecda8d8aa9689ce2a3c7a6c77394d7b286bfde4b3ed832f.png] 

3) Mansi is not the immediate neighbour of Kajal.

4) Laxmi is second to the left of Mansi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0ec97f557c1a500e5592e0132a71ee80039603641a5206798a0b342ed5225f5.png] 

5) Payal is not the immediate neighbour of Laxmi.

After positioning Payal only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Shweta.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0adc681c8d9b239c75471e960edc526d5844986c95e7948c009d49fde477393f.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Kajal is second to the left of Laxmi.

Hence, **"Kajal"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Words given on the left side of (::) are related with each other by some Logic Rule/Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/ Relation.

Time : Seconds :: ?
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Concept being measured : Specific unit to measure it

**Given :**

 
• Time : Seconds

**Seconds** is a unit of measurement for **time**. 

So,

 
• Option - (1) : Pressure : Litre ⇒Incorrect

Pressure is measured using a unit called pascal and litre is a unit of measurement for volume in the international system of units.

 
• Option - (2) : Newton : Force ⇒Incorrect

Newton is a unit of measurement for force.

 
• Option - (3) : Joule : Work ⇒Incorrect

Joule is a unit of measurement for work.

 
• Option - (4) : Power : Watt ⇒**Correct**

**Watt** is a unit of measurement for **power**.

Hence, **"Option - (4)"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two numbers what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively? 

8 and 2

I. 3 + 6 - 8 × 4 ÷ 2

II. 4 ÷ 6 × 9 + 2 - 8
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

According to the question, after interchanging the given two numbers i.e :

__
 
• Two numbers 8 and 2

So,

I. 3 + 6 - 8 × 4 ÷ 2 → 3 + 6 - 2 × **4 ÷ 8**__

⇒ 3 + 6 - __**2 × **____**0.5**__

⇒ __**3 + 6**__ - 1

⇒ __9 - 1__

⇒ **8**

II. 4 ÷ 6 × 9 + 2 - 8 → __**4 ÷ 6**__ × 9 + 8 - 2

⇒ __**0.66 **____**× 9**__ + 8 - 2

⇒ __6____ + 8__ - 2

⇒ __14 - 2__

⇒ 12

Here, values of equation (I) and (II) are (8) and (12) respectively.

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.
